plain_english: Then, for the suitable adept, the secret rule is stated; then all worship is said to be kula procedure.

plain_english: What arises in one month for one appointed to the accomplished order would not arise in a thousand years through various floods of mantras.

plain_english: The supreme kula, inclined to give the deathless state, establishes even the unawakened.

plain_english: The deities in that devised wheel attain knowledge in the power wheel.

plain_english: The wheel-lord too surges with impetuosity, by previously stated reasoning, from power stirred by filling the inner-wheel deities.

plain_english: In drinking, enjoyment, play, laughter, etc., one who becomes reflection-filled does so by unmanifest sound, explosion, hearing, sound, and end.

plain_english: In the union yoga called body-end, the pair-wheel carries an unmanifest sound from breast and heart region to the lip end.

sanskrit_cite: sarvadā smaraṇaṃ kṛtvā ādiyāgaikatatparaḥ śaktidehe nije nyasyedvidyāṃ kūṭamanukramāt

plain_english: Having meditated on the moon-like lotus self with sun radiance and knowledge mantra, one should unite the two seats here.
sanskrit_cite: dhyātvā candranibhaṃ padmamātmānaṃ bhāskaradyutim vidyāmantrātmakaṃ pīṭhadvayamatraiva melayet

plain_english: Because of secrecy, it is not read with clear words; again, the curious one should infer it from the stated scripture recitation alone.
sanskrit_cite: na paṭhyate rahasyatvātspaṣṭaiḥ śabdairmayā punaḥ kutūhalī tūktaśāstrasaṃpāṭhādeva lakṣayet

plain_english: That wheel which all always worship, and which god and goddess possess, is supreme and causes presence at the beginning of goddess worship.
sanskrit_cite: yadbhajante sadā sarve yadvān devaśca devatā taccakraṃ paramaṃ devīyāgādau saṃnidhāpakam

plain_english: The body indeed is the supreme mark, containing all principles, Shiva, joined with the goddess wheel, the best abode of worship.
sanskrit_cite: deha eva paraṃ liṅgaṃ sarvatattvātmakaṃ śivam devatācakrasaṃjuṣṭaṃ pūjādhāma taduttamam

plain_english: That same circle is principal, trident-lotus-wheel-space; there indeed the goddess wheel is always worshipped outside and inside.
sanskrit_cite: tadeva maṇḍalaṃ mukhyaṃ tritriśūlābjacakrakham tatraiva devatācakraṃ bahirantaḥ sadā yajet

plain_english: After recalling one's own mantra, with those births and juices abundant in joy, by the rite of creation and destruction, one should touch.
sanskrit_cite: svasvamantraparāmarśapūrvaṃ tajjanmabhī rasaiḥ ānandabahulaiḥ sṛṣṭisaṃhāravidhinā spṛśet

plain_english: The consciousness wheel aroused by the impetus of touch, its lord obtains the supreme abode, having satisfied all deities.
sanskrit_cite: tatsparśarabhasodbuddhasaṃviccakraṃ tadīśvaraḥ labhate paramaṃ dhāma tarpitāśeṣadaivataḥ

plain_english: By the prescribed follow-up rite, with heart-stealing substances, likewise from one's own desire recollection within, one should fully satisfy.
sanskrit_cite: anuyāgoktavidhinā dravyairhṛdayahāribhiḥ tathaiva svasvakāmarśayogādantaḥ pratarpayet

plain_english: Having made support-bearing, with mind-taken wonder-juice instantly sprinkled, with nature flowers abundant in own fragrance, from the sequence of the invaluable cup of one's own heart full of bliss nectar, I worship you together with the goddess in the body temple night and day.
sanskrit_cite: kṛtvādhāradharāṃ camatkṛtirasaprokṣākṣaṇakṣālitāmāttairmānasataḥ svabhāvakusumaiḥ svāmodasandohibhiḥ ānandāmṛtanirbharasvahṛdayānarghārghapātrakramāt tvāṃ devyā saha dehadevasadane devārcaye@harniśam

plain_english: From the boundary of Sri Vira-avali onward in the scripture collection, this supreme sacrifice is praised by the moon-crested one.
sanskrit_cite: śrīvīrāvalyamaryādaprabhṛtau śāstrasañcaye sa eṣa paramo yāgaḥ stutaḥ śītāṃśumaulinā

plain_english: Or, seeing all the group of deities situated in breath function by the previously stated method, the teacher should worship them there indeed.
sanskrit_cite: athavā prāṇavṛttisthaṃ samastaṃ devatāgaṇam paśyetpūrvoktayuktyaiva tatraivābhyarcayedguruḥ

plain_english: Satisfaction of the breath-supported goddesses is by brahma-nose and other distinctions, by hand holes entering the apana moon wheel.
sanskrit_cite: prāṇāśritānāṃ devīnāṃ brahmanāsādibhedibhiḥ karandhrairviśatāpānacāndracakreṇa tarpaṇam

plain_english: Thus by breath sequence indeed one should satisfy the deity group; soon by its grace one then attains knowledge accomplishments.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ prāṇakrameṇaiva tarpayeddevatāgaṇam acirāttatprasādena jñānasiddhīrathāśnute

plain_english: The goddess-circle, situated in consciousness alone, is to be satisfied by the wise through universal enjoyment, from the mirror of consciousness.
sanskrit_cite: saṃvinmātrasthitaṃ devīcakraṃ vā saṃvidarpaṇāt viśvābhogaprayogeṇa tarpaṇīyaṃ vipaścitā

plain_english: Where all elements dissolve and burn, see that consciousness residing in the body, equal in splendor to the fire of time.
sanskrit_cite: yatra sarve layaṃ yānti dahyante tattvasañcayāḥ tāṃ citiṃ paśya kāyasthāṃ kālānalasamaprabhām

plain_english: In this void-formed cremation ground, served by yoginis and siddhas, a play-place, greatly fierce, where all forms are set.
sanskrit_cite: śūnyarūpe śmaśāne@smin yoginīsiddhasevite krīḍāsthāne mahāraudre sarvāstamitavigrahe

plain_english: Filled with circles of sound-rays, with darkness continuously destroyed, free from all conceptual distinctions, alone in the state of bliss.
sanskrit_cite: svaraśmimaṇḍalākīrṇe dhvaṃsitadhvāntasantatau sarvairvikalpairnirmukte ānandapadakevale

plain_english: In the cremation ground filled with countless consciousness, terrifying consciousness, support of all deities, who entering does not become accomplished?
sanskrit_cite: asaṃkhyacitisaṃpūrṇe śmaśāne citibhīṣaṇe samastadevatādhāre praviṣṭaḥ ko na siddhyati

plain_english: In the glorious Viravali scripture, Bhairavi spoke thus: having first performed sacrifice, for one fit for such propriety.
sanskrit_cite: śrīmadvīrāvalīśāstre itthaṃ provāca bhairavī itthaṃ yāgaṃ vidhāyādau tādṛśaucityabhāginam

plain_english: Having discerned the family, initiate one's own disciple in such a rite; by Rudra-power sprinkle him and place him near the deities.
sanskrit_cite: lakṣaikīyaṃ svaśiṣyaṃ taṃ dīkṣayettādṛśi krame rudraśaktyā tu taṃ prokṣya devābhyāśe niveśayet

plain_english: Having observed his arms, kindle them by Rudra-power; with that same power offer flower to his hands anointed with scent.
sanskrit_cite: bhujau tasya samālokya rudraśaktyā pradīpayet tayaivāsyārpayetpuṣpaṃ karayorgandhadigdhayoḥ

plain_english: Having placed his two unsupported arms, one should think of them as drawn by Rudra-power in the form of a blazing hook.
sanskrit_cite: nirālambau tu tau tasya sthāpayitvā vicintayet rudraśaktyākṛṣyamāṇau dīptayāṅkuśarūpayā

plain_english: Then he himself takes cloth and becomes blindfolded; he himself drops the flower, and from that fall one discerns the family.
sanskrit_cite: tataḥ sa svayamādāya vastraṃ baddhadṛśirbhavet svayaṃ ca pātayetpuṣpaṃ tatpātāllakṣayetkulam

plain_english: Then, opening his mouth, make him bow at the feet; on his hands and head also worship the goddess-circle.
sanskrit_cite: tato@sya mukhamuddhāṭya pādayoḥ praṇipātayet hastayormūrdhni cāpyasya devīcakraṃ samarcayet

plain_english: In the glorious Ratnamala it is said: by attractor-attracted and impeller-impelled relation, the navel is a bowl with a staff.
sanskrit_cite: ākarṣyākarṣakatvena preryaprerakabhāvataḥ uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nābhiṃ daṇḍena saṃpuṭam

plain_english: By left-ornament thighs, adorned too at hip — in the disciple-hand flower-bearing, employ the impulsion-weapon.
sanskrit_cite: vāmabhūṣaṇajaṅghābhyāṃ nitambenāpyalaṅkṛtam śiṣyahaste puṣpabhṛte codanāstraṃ tu yojayet

plain_english: While that arrives with stobha, itself falls on the head — Shiva-hand itself, this very causes immediate conviction.
sanskrit_cite: yāvatsa stobhamāyātaḥ svayaṃ patati mūrdhani śivahastaḥ svayaṃ so@yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ

plain_english: By this very procedure the guru should have him take caruka — and by the disciple tooth-stick; its falling as before indeed.
sanskrit_cite: anenaiva prayogeṇa carukaṃ grāhayedguruḥ śiṣyeṇa dantakāṣṭhaṃ ca tatpātaḥ prāgvadeva tu

plain_english: Hand-clap onward from eye-band-taking indeed — up to tooth-stick-taking there one should observe.
sanskrit_cite: karastobho netrapaṭagrahāt prabhṛti yaḥ kila dantakāṣṭhasamādānaparyantastatra lakṣayet

plain_english: By intense mild and other differences, such power-descent — thus this samayin is declared in Sripurva, from Karakampa.
sanskrit_cite: tīvramandādibhedena śaktipātaṃ tathāvidham ityeṣa samayī proktaḥ śrīpūrve karakampataḥ

plain_english: At appointed time, from hand-clap thus — in auspicious enjoyment-hand as it were — the guru should give left-nectar-flooded.
sanskrit_cite: samayī tu karastobhāditi śrībhogahastake carveva vā gururdadyādvāmāmṛtapariplutam

plain_english: Without doubt, from taking, power-clan, maya-abandoned he may become — trembling in taking may be the initiate in recitations and the rest.
sanskrit_cite: niḥśaṅkaṃ grahaṇācchaktigotro māyojjhito bhavet sakampastvādadānaḥ syāt samayī vācanādiṣu

plain_english: In another time, by destruction-purification, from maintenance of established convention — as vessel of accomplishment, glorious bliss-lord, it is said.
sanskrit_cite: kālāntare@dhvasaṃśuddhyā pālanātsamayasthiteḥ siddhipātramiti śrīmadānandeśvara ucyate

plain_english: But when making a son, then perform initiation — as said in Sriratnamala: nada-to-pha-ending, blazing splendor.
sanskrit_cite: yadā tu putrakaṃ kuryāttadā dīkṣāṃ samācaret uktaṃ śrīratnamālāyāṃ nādiphāntāṃ jvalatprabhām

plain_english: Having placed desire-end, it falls — by that here such order holds: of the sprinkled one, the child's placed-spoken purified-path method.
sanskrit_cite: nyasyecchikhāntaṃ patati tenātredṛk kramo bhavet prokṣitasya śiśornyastaproktaśodhyādhvapaddhateḥ

plain_english: Of the straight-bodied, power arrived from feet to head, bonds-burning, blazing — the guru, identified with that, should meditate.
sanskrit_cite: ṛjudehajuṣaḥ śaktiṃ pādānmūrdhāntamāgatām pāśāndahantīṃ saṃdīptāṃ cintayettanmayo guruḥ

plain_english: Having sat down, then from root-purification onward enough — up to end-purification's end, meditate the burning in order.
sanskrit_cite: upaviśya tatastasya mūlaśodhyāt prabhṛtyalam antaśodhyāvasānāntāṃ dahantīṃ cintayetkramāt

plain_english: Thus all principles and so forth are purified, burned, and dissolved, then one meditates on Shiva, whether partless or with parts.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ sarvāṇi śodhyāni tattvādīni puroktavat dagdhvā līnāṃ śive dhyāyenniṣkale sakale@thavā

plain_english: The yogi on the path nourishes what is of the same kind and burns the cluster of what is of a different kind.
sanskrit_cite: yoginā yojitā mārge sajātīyasya poṣaṇam kurute nirdahatyantadbhinnajātikadambakam

plain_english: By this purification, the child's inner and outer bodies are affected by the descent of power according to intensity and related distinctions.
sanskrit_cite: anayā śodhyamānasya śiśostīvrādibhedataḥ śaktipātāccitivyomaprāṇanāntarbahistanūḥ

plain_english: Entering gradually, Rudra power produces this fruit: arising bliss, trembling, sleep, reeling, and other body-occurring signs.
sanskrit_cite: āviśantī rudraśaktiḥ kramātsūte phalaṃ tvidam ānandamudbhavaṃ kampaṃ nidrāṃ ghūrṇiṃ ca dehagām

plain_english: Thus for the self whose bonds are stilled and who is joined in Shiva, one should make creation going to purified principles for remaining enjoyment.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ stobhitapāśasya yojitasyātmanaḥ śive śeṣabhogāya kurvīta sṛṣṭiṃ saṃśuddhatattvagām

plain_english: Or for some there is not such possession; by the stated power it burns inside and outside, and thus he falls to the earth.
sanskrit_cite: athavā kasyacinnaivamāveśastaddahedimam bahirantaścoktaśaktyā pateditthaṃ sa bhūtale

plain_english: If even thus it would not occur, recognize and abandon that one; then I will teach initiation with cognition to the pleased and wise.
sanskrit_cite: yasya tvevamapi syānna tamatropalavattyajet atha sapratyayāṃ dīkṣāṃ vakṣye tuṣṭena dhīmatā

plain_english: Taught by Lord Shambhu and seen in the teaching of true being are nectar-fire-winds and weak and other fire-winds.
sanskrit_cite: śaṃbhunāthenopadiṣṭāṃ dṛṣṭāṃ sadbhāvaśāsane sudhāgnimaruto mandaparakālāgnivāyavaḥ

plain_english: Fire, palace-peak fire, and wind, all with sixty, are said for each; this threefold mass causes stopping.
sanskrit_cite: vahnisaudhāsukūṭāgnivāyuḥ sarve saṣaṣṭhakāḥ etatpiṇḍatrayaṃ stobhakāri pratyekamucyate

plain_english: The remembered power seed should be placed all over the limbs, but that mantra adorned with twelve vowels is placed in the heart circle.
sanskrit_cite: śaktibījaṃ smṛtaṃ yacca nyasyetsārvāṅgikaṃ tu tat hṛccakre nyasyate mantro dvādaśasvarabhūṣitaḥ

plain_english: Consciousness resembling a hibiscus flower, with wind impelling from its middle and fire fully illuminating the wheel.
sanskrit_cite: japākusumasaṃkāśaṃ caitanyaṃ tasya madhyataḥ vāyunā preritaṃ cakraṃ vahninā paridīpitam

plain_english: One should meditate on that and chant the mantra by name-separated union; from half a blink, stopping occurs for the disciple, without doubt.
sanskrit_cite: taddhyāyecca japenmantraṃ nāmāntaritayogataḥ nimeṣārdhāttu śiṣyasya bhavetstobho na saṃśayaḥ

plain_english: O goddess, while appointed to each principle, one sees the self; but until the supreme principle is reached, this one does not see it.
sanskrit_cite: ātmānaṃ prekṣate devi tattve tattve niyojitaḥ yāvatprāptaḥ paraṃ tattvaṃ tadā tveṣa na paśyati

plain_english: By this gradual union he sees all paths, or instantly grasps all scriptures.
sanskrit_cite: anena kramayogena sarvādhvānaṃ sa paśyati athavā sarvaśāstrāṇyapyudgrāhayati tatkṣaṇāt

plain_english: The accomplished yogi performs initiation for one fit, by method of principle practice, in separate principle rite.
sanskrit_cite: pṛthaktattvavidhau dīkṣāṃ yogyatāvaśavartinaḥ tattvābhyāsavidhānena siddhayogī samācaret

plain_english: Thus for this initiated seeker of liberation, in remaining conduct, the kul instruction endowed with five states is to be taught.
sanskrit_cite: iti saṃdīkṣitasyāsya mumukṣoḥ śeṣavartane kulakrameṣṭirādeśyā pañcāvasthāsamanvitā

plain_english: As consciousness may be unfailing in waking etc., so the kul rite is to be taught, situated in the yogini's mouth.
sanskrit_cite: jāgradādiṣu saṃvittiryathā syādanapāyinī kulayāgastathādeśyo yoginīmukhasaṃsthitaḥ

plain_english: All to be done in waking; in dream, restraining per-mantra going; in sleep, the root-named expanded by own power.
sanskrit_cite: sarvaṃ jāgrati kartavyaṃ svapne pratyekamantragam nivārya supte mūlākhyaḥ svaśaktiparibṛṃhitaḥ

plain_english: In the fourth, only the messenger-named; beyond that, kul-lordship; thus worship proceeds for those full of own power.
sanskrit_cite: turye tvekaiva dūtyākhyā tadatīte kuleśitā svaśaktiparipūrṇānāmitthaṃ pūjā pravartate

plain_english: The body-residence etc. and previously said five states ending in all-transcended, with stated distinction, he should explain to him.
sanskrit_cite: piṇḍasthādi ca pūrvoktaṃ sarvātītāvasānakam avasthāpañcakaṃ proktabhedaṃ tasmai nirūpayet

plain_english: For the practitioner desiring enjoyment, proper yoga consecration; having worshipped the god with resources, flawless made of gold etc.
sanskrit_cite: sādhakasya bubhukṣostu samyagyogābhiṣecanam tatreṣṭvā vibhavairdevaṃ hemādimayamavraṇam

plain_english: Filling eight lamps with red wick and ghee, he should awaken; that worshipable in conch, and also the two kul lords.
sanskrit_cite: dīpāṣṭakaṃ raktavartisarpiṣāpūrya bodhayet kulāṣṭakena tatpūjyaṃ śaṅkhe cāpi kuleśvarau

plain_english: In full bliss-nectar, by path spoken by Shiva's hand, consecrate him with that; afterwards he should do mantra accomplishment.
sanskrit_cite: ānandāmṛtasaṃpūrṇe śivahastoktavartmanā tenābhiṣiñcettaṃ paścāt sa kuryānmantrasādhanam

plain_english: This teacher's consecration endowed with authority; but he should do with flour etc. and his sixty-four lamps.
sanskrit_cite: ācāryasyābhiṣeko@yamadhikārānvitaḥ sa tu kuryātpiṣṭādibhiścāsya catuṣṣaṣṭiṃ pradīpakān

plain_english: By eight octads they are worshipped — in the middle as before, the two kula-lords; by Shiva-hand-stated method alone consecrate the guru too.
sanskrit_cite: aṣṭāṣṭakena pūjyāste madhye prāgvat kuleśvarau śivahastoktayuktyaiva gurumapyabhiṣecayet

plain_english: These two thus consecrated, known by the whole yogin host — of you there, the guru becomes liberation-giver.
sanskrit_cite: abhiṣiktāvimāvevaṃ sarvayogigaṇena tu viditau bhavatastatra gururmokṣaprado bhavet

plain_english: This foot's intent: he grants siddhis — the guru who was practitioner before; the other gives liberation enough.
sanskrit_cite: tātparyamasya pādasya sa siddhīḥ saṃprayacchati gururyaḥ sādhakaḥ prāksyādanyo mokṣaṃ dadātyalam

plain_english: Of the two tell knowledge threefold, all indeed sufficient — and own-ignorance bestow toward own-action-making.
sanskrit_cite: anayoḥ kathayejjñānaṃ trividhaṃ sarvamapyalam svakīyājñāṃ ca vitaret svakriyākaraṇaṃ prati

plain_english: The sixfold cause-named — which thus — who is supreme Shiva, together with Bhairava-lord: that octad described.
sanskrit_cite: ṣaṭkaṃ kāraṇasaṃjñaṃ yattathā yaḥ paramaḥ śivaḥ sākaṃ bhairavanāthena tadaṣṭakamudāhṛtam

plain_english: Individually seeing that all-selfhood, self-reaching activity — in eye and the rest the teacher transfers wherever, in whichever sense.
sanskrit_cite: pratyekaṃ tasya sārvātmyaṃ paśyaṃstāṃ vṛttimātmagām cakṣurādau saṃkramayedyatra yatrendriye guruḥ

plain_english: That indeed with full pitchers is supreme consecration declared — without externals too, so said in Sriviravali-Bhairava.
sanskrit_cite: sa eva pūrṇaiḥ kalaśairabhiṣekaḥ paraḥ smṛtaḥ vinā bāhyairapītyuktaṃ śrīvīrāvalibhairave

plain_english: Immediately indeed for the enjoyment-seeker, most-perfected by yoga, the guru would do at once thus desired-fruit-giving piercing-initiation.
sanskrit_cite: sadya eva tu bhogepsoryogātsiddhatamo guruḥ kuryātsadyastathābhīṣṭaphaladaṃ vedhadīkṣaṇam

plain_english: Piercing-initiation in many ways there determined — and by the practitioner to be done through ascending entry.
sanskrit_cite: vedhadīkṣā ca bahudhā tatra tatra nirūpitā sā cābhyāsavatā kāryā yenordhvordhvapraveśataḥ

plain_english: Of the disciple cakra-breaking conviction arises, certain — by which anima and the rest: accomplishment, in Srimala too it is taught.
sanskrit_cite: śiṣyasya cakrasaṃbhedapratyayo jāyate dhruvaḥ yenāṇimādikā siddhiḥ śrīmālāyāṃ ca coditā

plain_english: On attaining upper-wheel state, that is indeed demon-possession — of mantra-sound-bindu-power-serpent-supreme-self.
sanskrit_cite: ūrdhvacakradaśālābhe piśācāveśa eva sā mantranādabinduśaktibhujaṅgamaparātmikā

plain_english: Sixfold in the glorious Cave, piercing-initiation prescribed by the supreme Lord — fiery kula as own-scripture states, cakra beginning with eight stars.
sanskrit_cite: ṣoḍhā śrīgahvare vedhadīkṣoktā parameśinā jvālākulaṃ svaśāstroktaṃ cakramaṣṭārakādikam

plain_english: Having meditated, one transfers mantra piercing in nine forms into the body after heart-wheel piercing.
sanskrit_cite: dhyātvā tenāsya hṛccakravedhanānmantravedhanam ākāraṃ navadhā dehe nyasya saṃkramayettataḥ

plain_english: By placement yoga, the disciple is united with the supreme principle through a shining great flame after bond obstruction.
sanskrit_cite: nyāsayogena śiṣyāya dīpyamānaṃ mahārciṣam pāśastobhāttatastasya paratattve tu yojanam

plain_english: Thus the rule seen by me after initiation was spoken by Shambhu, with sound utterance according to creation order.
sanskrit_cite: iti dīkṣottare dṛṣṭo vidhirme śaṃbhunoditaḥ nādoccāreṇa nādākhyaḥ sṛṣṭikramaniyogataḥ

plain_english: By sound one pierces the mind; sound-piercing is declared for mind located at bindu and situated in the brow-middle path.
sanskrit_cite: nādena vedhayeccittaṃ nādavedha udīritaḥ bindusthānagataṃ cittaṃ bhrūmadhyapathasaṃsthitam

plain_english: O great goddess, in the heart target or bindu, the flame-radiant bindu awakens the object; this is proclaimed as bindu.
sanskrit_cite: hṛllakṣye vā maheśāni binduṃ jvālākulaprabham tena saṃbodhayetsādhyaṃ bindvākhyo@yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ

plain_english: O beautiful one, shakta piercing uses powerful scent utterance while seated in triangle posture, curved and coil-shaped.
sanskrit_cite: śāktaṃ śaktimaduccārādgandhoccāreṇa sundari śṛṅgāṭakāsanasthaṃ tu kuṭilaṃ kuṇḍalākṛtim

plain_english: By non-utterance, having uttered, one pierces the whole world; thus bee piercing declares shakta piercing.
sanskrit_cite: anuccāreṇa coccārya vedhayennikhilaṃ jagat evaṃ bhramaravedhena śāktavedha udāhṛtaḥ

plain_english: She indeed is supreme power expanding bliss; she goes beyond birth place adorned by five hoods.
sanskrit_cite: sā caiva paramā śaktirānandapravikāsinī janmasthānātparaṃ yāti phaṇapañcakabhūṣitā

plain_english: Arts, principles, nanda and others, spaces, families, and brahma causes and letters are indeed she, the five-formed.
sanskrit_cite: kalāstattvāni nandādyā vyomāni ca kulāni ca brahmādikāraṇānyakṣāṇyeva sā pañcakātmikā

plain_english: Thus she, the five kinds, emerging from brahma place and entering brahma place, shines absorbed in lightning.
sanskrit_cite: evaṃ pañcaprakārā sā brahmasthānavinirgatā brahmasthāne viśantī tu taḍillīnā virājate

plain_english: Having entered, she pierces body and self and splits apart; thus serpent piercing is told in Bhairava agama.
sanskrit_cite: praviṣṭā vedhayetkāyamātmānaṃ pratibhedayet evaṃ bhujaṅgavedhastu kathito bhairavāgame

plain_english: So long one meditates mind until mind is destroyed; when mind is exhausted, O goddess of gods, supreme bliss is declared.
sanskrit_cite: tāvadbhāvayate cittaṃ yāvaccittaṃ kṣayaṃ gatam kṣīṇe citte sureśāni parānanda udāhṛtaḥ

plain_english: Not senses, not indeed breaths, not inner-organ range — not mind, nor thinkable, not thinker, nor mind-act.
sanskrit_cite: nendriyāṇi na vai prāṇā nāntaḥkaraṇagocaraḥ na mano nāpi mantavyaṃ na mantā na manikriyā

plain_english: All states exhausted — the other-piercing declared: from mantra-power-world-form-knowledge-mass-station-channel supreme distinction.
sanskrit_cite: sarvabhāvaparikṣīṇaḥ paravedha udāhṛtaḥ manuśaktibhuvanarūpajñāpiṇḍasthānanāḍiparabhedāt

plain_english: Ninefold others reckon the Veda — teachers, secret-knowers — in maya-womb-fire-color-stream-joined three-cornered circle.
sanskrit_cite: navadhā kalayantyanye vedaṃ guravo rahasyavidaḥ māyāgarbhāgnivarṇaughayukte tryaśriṇi maṇḍale

plain_english: Having meditated, by terrible flame, by that split knots — with flowers strike and join; in the other, mantra-named rite.
sanskrit_cite: dhyātvā jvālākarālena tena granthīn vibhedayet puṣpairhanyādyojayecca pare mantrābhidho vidhiḥ

plain_english: By one of two nadis, consciousness in kanda-abode — concentrated, circulated — by five-eight flame, forcibly.
sanskrit_cite: nāḍyāviśyānyatarayā caitanyaṃ kandadhāmani piṇḍīkṛtya paribhramya pañcāṣṭaśikhayā haṭhāt

plain_english: Led to sakti-spear-tip, somewhere in the circle employ — by sakti thus, the sakta practitioner; this piercing causes immediate conviction.
sanskrit_cite: śaktiśūlāgragamitaṃ kvāpi cakre niyojayet śaktyeti śākto vedho@yaṃ sadyaḥpratyayakārakaḥ

plain_english: From support emerged, by moonlight-white flame, from impetuosity — by thumb-root-seat sequence of the disciple, absorbed, in sky.
sanskrit_cite: ādhārānnirgatayā śikhayā jyotsnāvadātayā rabhasāt aṅguṣṭhamūlapīṭhakrameṇa śiṣyasya līnayā vyomni

plain_english: Having purified the body — from ksa to end, remembering previously mentioned city-multitudes — from own-circle meditation reflects: world-piercing.
sanskrit_cite: dehaṃ svacchīkṛtya kṣādīnāntān smaranpuroktapuryoghān nijamaṇḍalanirdhyānātpratibimbayate bhuvanavedhaḥ

plain_english: Brow-middle-risen bindu-light-end, some beautiful form — by identity meditate the disciple, and afterwards make that-identified.
sanskrit_cite: bhrūmadhyoditabaindavadhāmāntaḥ kāṃcidākṛtiṃ rucirām tādātmyena dhyāyecchiṣyaṃ paścācca tanmayīkuryāt

plain_english: Thus form-piercing said; and here form approaches visibility — at end, union with that; the disciple comes, become that.
sanskrit_cite: iti rūpavedha uktaḥ sā cehākṛtirupaiti dṛśyatvam ante tatsāyujyaṃ śiṣyaścāyāti tanmayībhūtaḥ

plain_english: Eightfold knowledge — smell-and-rest named-faculty-ended — that, by own-nadi-thread order, cause to move in the disciple.
sanskrit_cite: vijñānamaṣṭadhā yaddhrāṇādikabuddhisaṃjñakaraṇāntaḥ tat svasvanāḍisūtrakrameṇa saṃcārayecchiṣye

plain_english: By pride-firmness-binding sequence, consciousness-named piercing — in heart-space immediately bears divine-knowledge-sun rising.
sanskrit_cite: abhimānadārḍhyabandhakrameṇa vijñānasaṃjñako vedhaḥ hṛdayavyomani sadyo divyajñānārkasamudayaṃ dhatte

plain_english: The body is supreme in subtle essence and gross in shadow form; it is known facing or turned away from mirror-like supports.
sanskrit_cite: piṇḍaḥ paraḥ kalātmā sūkṣmaḥ puryaṣṭako bahiḥ sthūlaḥ chāyātmā sa parāṅmukha ādarśādau ca saṃmukho jñeyaḥ

plain_english: Thus one pacifies body divisions swiftly and gradually through channels, reaching supreme state by body piercing.
sanskrit_cite: iti yaḥ piṇḍavibhedastaṃ rabhasāduttarottare śamayet tattadnalane kramaśaḥ paramapadaṃ piṇḍavedhena

plain_english: Whatever wheel is in the body, going to infant rest, gradually brightens that wheel; piercing gives named place and fruit.
sanskrit_cite: yadyaddehe cakraṃ tatra śiśoretya viśramaṃ kramaśaḥ ujjvalayettaccakraṃ sthānākhyastatphalaprado vedhaḥ

plain_english: Channels are three principal and others innumerable; unification by them is channel piercing here, making fruit.
sanskrit_cite: nāḍyaḥ pradhānabhūtāstisro@nyāstadgatāstvasaṃkhyeyāḥ ekīkārastābhirnāḍīvedho@tra tatphalakṛt

plain_english: In channel piercing, desired channel flow with principal endings like eye gives varied knowledge attainment.
sanskrit_cite: abhilaṣitanāḍivāho mukhyābhiścakṣurādiniṣṭhābhiḥ adbodhaprāptiḥ syānnāḍīvedhe vicitrabahurūpā

plain_english: The great yogi, by force, bursts the other channel enclosed by the strong tail-shaped channel and casts it down on earth.
sanskrit_cite: lāṅgūlākṛtibalavat svanāḍisaṃvoṣṭitāmaparanāḍīm āsphoṭya siddhamapi bhuvi pātayati haṭhānmahāyogī

plain_english: Touching nonduality in all wheels through supreme piercing, the teacher should make supreme Shiva, giving Shiva state.
sanskrit_cite: paravedhaṃ samasteṣu cakreṣvadvaitamāmṛśan paraṃ śivaṃ prakurvīta śivatāpattido guruḥ

plain_english: Thus determined in the Shri Viravali lineage: the indivisible middle is to be known in every way; knowing it, one is not stained.
sanskrit_cite: śrīmadvīrāvalikule tathā cetthaṃ nirūpitam abhedyaṃ sarvathā jñeyaṃ madhyaṃ jñātvā na lipyate

plain_english: In that division order, the accomplished teacher liberates bound beings; the disciple enters before the teacher, and mouth pierces mouth.
sanskrit_cite: tadvibhāgakrame siddhaḥ sa gururmocayet paśūn guroragre viśecchiṣyo vaktraṃ vaktre tu vedhayet

plain_english: Form in form unifies with objects; when mind becomes unified, the two attain a beyond-mind state.
sanskrit_cite: rūpaṃ rūpe tu viṣayairyāvatsamarasībhavet citte samarasībhūte dvayoraunmanasī sthitiḥ

plain_english: By mind movement of both, at that time one becomes initiated; in moon-sun union the living being goes to that identity.
sanskrit_cite: ubhayośconmanogatyā tatkāle dīkṣito bhavet śaśibhāskarasaṃyoge jīvastanmayatāṃ vrajet

plain_english: Here gods from Brahma, desiring liberation, restrain their own ray wheel for both enjoyment and liberation.
sanskrit_cite: atra brahmādayo devā muktaye mokṣakāṅkṣiṇaḥ nirudhya raśmicakraṃ svaṃ bhogamokṣāvubhāvapi

plain_english: If that initiation is proclaimed as Shiva's, this motionless liberation is told for all beings.
sanskrit_cite: grasate yadi taddīkṣā śārvīyaṃ parikīrtitā sa eṣa mokṣaḥ kathito niḥspandaḥ sarvajantuṣu

plain_english: From the striking union of fire and moon parts, pulsation removes external breath gone outward through darkness-form union.
sanskrit_cite: agnīṣomakalāghātasaṅghātāt spandanaṃ haret bāhyaṃ prāṇaṃ bāhyagataṃ timirākārayogataḥ

plain_english: Gone out through hair pores, wandering with all causes, taking the unmarked middle, it makes wander and releases.
sanskrit_cite: niryātaṃ romakūpaistu bhramantaṃ sarvakāraṇaiḥ madhyaṃ nirlakṣyamāsthāya bhramayedvisṛjettataḥ

plain_english: By union and uprooting method, pierce the five knots; contemplate the union activity pair in the middle abode.
sanskrit_cite: saṃghaṭṭotpāṭayogena vedhayedgranthipañcakam saṃghaṭṭavṛttiyugalaṃ madhyadhāma vicintayet

plain_english: One should not join self, space, outside, mantra, and body; this initiation gives Shiva state to all beings.
sanskrit_cite: nātmavyomabahirmantradehasaṃdhānamācaret dīkṣeyaṃ sarvajantūnāṃ śivatāpattidāyikā

plain_english: At initiation end, having cooked lamps, the offering should be eaten with all adepts by clan teachers destroying great sin.
sanskrit_cite: dīkṣānte dīpakān paktvā samastaiḥ sādhakaiḥ saha caruḥ prāśyaḥ kulācāryairmahāpātakanāśanaḥ

plain_english: Thus in Shri Ratnamala, the extra rite indeed pacifies that sin, and this pacification is proclaimed.
sanskrit_cite: iti śrīratnamālāyāmūnādhikavidhistu yaḥ sa eva pātakaṃ tasya praśamo@yaṃ prakīrtitaḥ

plain_english: Next day the teacher's sacrifice should be done by him, because without it the rite does not reach completeness; do that with effort then.
sanskrit_cite: pare@hani guroḥ kāryo yāgastena vinā yataḥ na vidhiḥ pūrṇatāṃ yāti kuryādyatnena taṃ tataḥ

plain_english: By which the teacher is pleased, that should be offered to him; in the circle rite interval, movement is called the rite.
sanskrit_cite: yena yena gurustuṣyettattadasmai nivedayet cakracaryāntarāle@syā vidhiḥ saṃcāra ucyāte

plain_english: Having seen the well-filled bee vessel placed in the hero lord's hand, supreme Brahman, that should be drunk by the teacher's command.
sanskrit_cite: alipātraṃ susaṃpūrṇaṃ vīrendrakarasaṃsthitam avalokya paraṃ brahma tatpivedājñayā guroḥ

plain_english: Having satisfied beings, one should offer to the teacher; having made the teacher on earth, bowed and taken, satisfying sky-goers.
sanskrit_cite: tarpayitvā tu bhūtāni gurave vinivedayet kṛtvā bhuvi guruṃ natvādāya saṃtarpya khecarīḥ

plain_english: Having saluted own mantra, and that, female messenger, Ganapati, teachers, field protector, hero group, then by teacher order.
sanskrit_cite: svaṃ mantraṃ tacca vanditvā dūtīṃ gaṇaptiṃ gurūn kṣetrapaṃ vīrasaṅghātaṃ gurvādikramaśastataḥ

plain_english: The substance touched by the hero should be drunk by oneself, never otherwise; those who know supreme Brahman are free from coming and going.
sanskrit_cite: vīraspṛṣṭaṃ svayaṃ dravyaṃ pivennaivānyathā kvacit parabrahmaṇyavettāro@gamāgamavivarjitāḥ

plain_english: This should not be done together with those possessed of greed, delusion, pride, anger, attachment, and deceit, by one seeking welfare for oneself.
sanskrit_cite: lobhamohamadakrodharāgamāyājuṣaśca ye taiḥ sākaṃ na ca kartavyametacchreyorthinātmani

plain_english: At the beginning, middle, and end of sacrifice, in guru worship, and in prescribed occasional rites, the disciple should perform this rite.
sanskrit_cite: yāgādau yāgamadhye ca yāgānte gurupūjane naimittikeṣu prokteṣu śiṣyaḥ kuryādimaṃ vidhim

plain_english: Thus the secret rite has been discussed and is very clear from the guru's mouth-experience.
sanskrit_cite: iti rahasyavidhiḥ paricarcito gurumukhānubhavaiḥ suparisphuṭaḥ
